from threetears.evals import Eval

from contacts import Contact, same_person

def decide(case):
    """Whether the merge takes the pair for one person."""
    left = Contact.from_row(case["left"], case["left_source"])
    right = Contact.from_row(case["right"], case["right_source"])
    return {"same": bool(same_person(left, right))}


def as_reviewed(case, out):
    """The merge decides the pair as the reviewer did."""
    return out["same"] == case["same"]

pairs = Eval("data/reviewed_pairs.jsonl", runner=decide, grader=[as_reviewed], k=1)
